title: Die Leere zwischen den Zeilen — lines that stutter into stacked echoes
note: Some lines repeat themselves as you scroll past: "Nähe überall sichtbar" (closeness visible everywhere) piles up as about a dozen copies, each shifted a few pixels down and sideways, until it is a smudged block; "Nach jedem Reel, hoffe ich" does the same, and "Moment." repeats down the page. The copies are plain text layers, scrubbed by scroll. Worth reusing: repetition as the effect, a cheap DOM trick that reads like doomscrolling or an echo, and works with any line of copy.
